# Summons reference

The components on a caster and its summons, the companion AI, and the ability effect that summons units. For how to use it, see [Summons](../modules/summons.md).

## VtUnitSummons

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Summons → VtUnitSummons**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

The summons a unit currently controls. Added to the caster by `VtSummonEffect` the first time it summons. Your pet bar reads `Active` and calls `DismissAll` or `SetStance`; both forward on a networked client.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyList<VtSummon> Active { get; }` | Live summons in the order they were summoned. |
| `event Action<VtSummon> OnSummoned` | Fires after a summon was bound to this unit. |
| `event Action<VtSummon> OnSummonEnded` | Fires after a summon ended. |
| `int CountFrom(VtSummonEffect source)` | Live summons created by `source`, not counting ones already ending. |
| `VtSummon OldestFrom(VtSummonEffect source)` | The earliest live summon created by `source`, or null. |
| `bool DismissAll()` | End every summon. False when there were none, or on a networked client. |
| `bool SetStance(VtCompanionStance stance)` | Set the stance of every summon with a companion AI. False when none has one, or on a networked client. |

## VtSummon

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Summons → VtSummon**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

Marks a unit as summoned by an owner: fights for the owner's faction, earns kill credit for the owner, counts as the owner's party, and ends when its lifetime runs out, when it dies, when the owner dies, or when dismissed. Added by `VtSummonEffect`; you rarely add it by hand.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit Unit { get; }` | The summoned unit. |
| `VtUnit Owner { get; }` | The unit this summon fights for, or null when it is gone. |
| `VtSummonEffect Source { get; }` | The effect that created this summon, or null for a replicated or hand-bound one. |
| `bool IsPermanent { get; }` | True when the summon has no lifetime and lasts until it dies or is dismissed. |
| `float SecondsRemaining { get; }` | Seconds of lifetime left; 0 for permanent summons. |
| `bool DismissOnOwnerDeath { get; }` | True when the owner's death ends this summon. |
| `bool IsEnding { get; }` | True once the summon is ending or has ended. |
| `event Action<VtSummon> OnEnded` | Fires once when the summon ends, just before it is despawned. |
| `void Bind(VtUnit newOwner, VtSummonEffect fromEffect, float lifetimeSeconds, bool inheritOwnerFaction, bool dismissWhenOwnerDies)` | Tie this unit to `newOwner`. Called by the summon effect on the authority. |
| `void ApplySummonFromNet(VtUnit newOwner, bool inheritOwnerFaction)` | Mirror the owner link on a replica. Not authority-gated. |
| `bool Dismiss()` | End the summon now. On the owner's networked client the request is forwarded. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Count down the lifetime and finish a pending end. Authority only. |
| `static VtUnit ResolveCreditUnit(VtUnit unit)` | The unit that earns credit for `unit`'s kills: its owner when it is a summon, following chains of summons, otherwise the unit itself. |
| `static VtUnitId ResolveCreditId(VtUnitId id)` | Id form of `ResolveCreditUnit`. Unknown ids come back unchanged. |

## VtCompanionAi

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Summons → VtCompanionAi**. Adds [VtSummon](#vtsummon) automatically.

Brain for a summon or pet: follows its owner, fights by `VtCompanionStance`, and teleports back when left too far behind. Added by `VtSummonEffect`; it switches off a `VtHostileAi` on the same unit so the two never fight over the target.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stance (`stance`) | [VtCompanionStance](#vtcompanionstance) | `Defensive` |  | How the companion fights. |
| Follow Distance (`followDistance`) | `float` | 3 | ≥ 0 | The companion stops following once it is this close to its owner. |
| Leash Distance (`leashDistance`) | `float` | 30 | ≥ 0 | Farther than this from its owner, the companion drops its target and teleports back. 0 = never. |
| Assist Range (`assistRange`) | `float` | 20 | ≥ 0 | Targets farther than this from the owner are ignored or dropped. |
| Think Interval (`thinkInterval`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between target decisions while idle. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IVtAttackable CurrentTarget { get; }` | The unit the companion is attacking, or null. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings and switch off a hostile AI on the same unit. Idempotent. |
| `void SetStance(VtCompanionStance newStance)` | Change how the companion fights. Passive drops the current target. Authority only. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance one decision step. Authority only. |

## VtSummonEffect

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Abilities → Effects → Summon**. Inherits [VtAbilityEffect](abilities.md#vtabilityeffect).

Ability effect: summon units that fight for the caster. Each summon gets a `VtSummon` tying it to the caster and, by default, a `VtCompanionAi` that follows and fights. Put it on a Self or Ground Point ability; ground point casts spawn around the point.

### Inspector fields

#### What

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prefab (`prefab`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Prefab with a VtUnit. Required. |
| Definition Override (`definitionOverride`) | [VtUnitDefinition](units.md#vtunitdefinition) | None |  | Definition to give the summon. Empty = the prefab's own. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Units spawned per cast. |

#### Limits

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max Active (`maxActive`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Most summons from this effect the caster may have at once. The oldest is dismissed to make room. 0 = no limit. |
| Lifetime Seconds (`lifetimeSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds each summon lasts. 0 = until it dies or is dismissed. |
| Dismiss On Owner Death (`dismissOnOwnerDeath`) | `bool` | On |  | End the summons when the caster dies. |

#### Behaviour

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spawn Radius (`spawnRadius`) | `float` | 1.5 | ≥ 0 | Distance from the caster or ground point at which summons appear, spread in a circle. |
| Inherit Owner Faction (`inheritOwnerFaction`) | `bool` | On |  | Summons fight for the caster's faction instead of their definition's. |
| Add Companion Ai (`addCompanionAi`) | `bool` | On |  | Add a VtCompanionAi so the summon follows and fights on its own. |
| Stance (`stance`) | [VtCompanionStance](#vtcompanionstance) | `Defensive` |  | Stance the companion AI starts in. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override void Execute(in VtAbilityContext ctx)` | Summon `count` units around the caster, or around the ground point for a ground point ability, dismissing the oldest first when `maxActive` is reached. |

## Enums

### VtCompanionStance

How a `VtCompanionAi` fights.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Passive` | Follows the owner and never attacks. |
| `Defensive` | Attacks what the owner attacks and whatever hurts the owner or the companion. |
| `Aggressive` | Like Defensive, and also attacks hostiles that come inside its aggro range. |
